Question
========
What is paraphrasing plagiarism?

Answerlist
----------
* repeating more than one sentence from the source without rewording it
* rewording without citation
* copying exact wording with citation
* summarizing incorrectly


Solution
========
Paraphrasing plagiarism is rewording without citation.

Answerlist
----------
* False
* True
* False
* False
